structural_claim: For any positive static constrained Hessian H0 and positive scalar inertia A, the enlarged quadratic energy is delta_u^T H0 delta_u+(delta_Pi-G delta_u)^T A^-1(delta_Pi-G delta_u), plus nonnegative scalar-gradient/matter-kinetic terms. Relaxing the shifted momenta gives exactly H0. Passive outgoing damping cannot increase this energy.
